correctness.rationale: Explicit exact-arithmetic algorithm, SPD matrix and sketch law. \(V=\sqrt{\ell} R^{-1}\) gives \(H=RAR^{-1}\), and symbolic expansion yields \(h_{13}=C_\ell/r_{33}\). Bartlett independent QR variables give \(r_{33}\sim\chi_{\ell-2}\), with \(C_\ell\) independent, nonzero and finite at moment \(\ell-2\); chi inverse moments prove the iff boundary. Small-chi CDF asymptotic and dominated convergence yield the stated exact tail constant, and chi concentration/Slutsky gives \(N(0,2)\). 900 direct Gaussian sketch Arnoldi-versus-QR comparisons and exact symbolic identities passed in a standalone verifier. No finite experiment is used to prove the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial above-tridiagonal noise coefficient in sketched Arnoldi is a natural benchmark because primary algorithmic analysis discusses its Gaussian appearance. An exact sharp sketch-size budget for existence of first, second and fourth moments—together with a Gaussian weak limit and a nonzero polynomial-tail constant—demonstrates that central Gaussian histograms and unconditional moment control are different mathematical claims. This is a structural, all-sketch-dimensions distribution result, not an arbitrary parameter example or a recomputation of a known table; it explicitly excludes unproved solver-performance consequences.
